gate.appliesTo: every admitted archetype, uniformly; no per-archetype values
gate.rationale: A blind judge reading passing traces rejected 27/52. Inspection showed evaluate band="critical" can be satisfied by spawn-time artifacts (minTTC=0 at t=0 with both actors stationary) or by scenes with 16-32 m separation and zero required deceleration. The gate is therefore TIGHTENED, never relaxed. v2 adds C6 after the round-6 audit found all 10 admitted C7 archetypes had declaredOcclusion EMPTY — occluderIneffective read 0 only because nothing was ever declared. This is a TIGHTENING; no criterion was loosened.
criteria: C1 motion: the ego must actually drive - maxSpeedMps >= 2.0 and distanceTravelledM >= 10.0
C2 not-a-spawn-artifact: the closest-approach and minTTC events must occur at t > warmupSeconds + 0.5 s
C3 genuine proximity: TRUE oriented-bounding-box clearance at closest approach <= 5.0 m (the engine minDistance is a circumscribed-circle broad-phase proxy and is not used)
C4 genuine demand: ego requiredDecelMax >= 1.5 m/s^2 OR minTTC <= 3.0 s
C5 all prior conditions: evaluate verdict=accept, band=critical, intent rubric accept, zero collisions, no never-fired trigger

C6 occlusion proof (ONLY for briefs whose mechanism is occlusion): the trace must carry a declaredOcclusion entry whose status shows the target was actually hidden and then revealed before the conflict (status "revealed_before_conflict" or "blocked_at_conflict"), and occluderIneffective must be empty. A brief that names occlusion as the mechanism but never blocks the sight line is NOT admitted.

reason: requirement B demands zero occlusion_unproven where occlusion is the mechanism. All 10 C7 archetypes had declaredOcclusion EMPTY, so occlusion was never proven. Withdrawn, not relaxed.
